title: Notifications of one chat
summary: Lets the person choose notifications for one chat: as in Settings, every message, only mentions (groups) or silenced. A silenced chat shows a muted icon in the chat list.

mode.description: The effective mode of this chat.

isDefault.description: true when the chat follows the Settings default.

defaultMode.description: The Settings default for this kind of chat, for the default option label.

mentionsMayMiss.description: Group in an encrypted room and the homeserver cannot push encrypted events to the device.

appear.effect: Reads the room notification settings for this room, encrypted or not, one-to-one or not.

useDefault.effect: Removes the custom rule of this chat, so it follows Settings.

mode.description: DM: all or off. Group: all, mentions or off.

setMode.effect: Sets the mode of this chat. A failure puts the old value back and shows bipe_error_generic.

notes: Title: bipe_dm_notifications_custom_title in a DM, bipe_group_screen_room_notification_settings_room_custom_settings_title in a group.
Options: bipe_app_notification_mode_default with the Settings mode label, then all, mentions (groups only), off. The selected option has a check.
DM (ADR 0141): every message and silenced only. A DM with an older mentions rule shows mentions as selected, with bipe_dm_notifications_mentions_disclaimer, until the person picks another option.
Group with mentions and mentionsMayMiss: bipe_group_screen_room_notification_settings_mentions_only_disclaimer under the option.
Opens from the chat details screen (people and groups issues). A muted chat shows a muted icon on its chat-list row; the unread badge stays, without sound or notification.
Leaving off for a chat uses unmuteRoom, so the room goes back to its previous mode.
